how do i add my openrouter key?

body.message:
To add your OpenRouter key, follow these steps: 
1. Open Settings using the gear icon at the top right (User guide: 13. Settings). 
2. Navigate to the Providers tab (User guide: 13. Settings). 
3. Enter your OpenRouter key in the designated field (User guide: 13. Settings). 
4. Save the key; it will be used for the next question without needing a restart (User guide: 13. Settings).
